title: What Happens If You Stop Drinking Water? 💧
description:
Your kidneys fight for every drop. Day by day, here is exactly what happens inside your body when you stop drinking water - and why about four days is the limit.

Sources:
- NHS, Dehydration (symptoms: thirst, dark urine, headache, dizziness, confusion)
- Ganio et al. 2011, Mild dehydration impairs cognitive performance and mood (PubMed)
- Guyton and Hall physiology: dehydration reduces plasma volume; hemoconcentration raises blood viscosity and heart rate
- US Army Survival Manual FM 3-05.70, rule of threes: about 3 days without water in normal conditions
- NIH/NCBI: dehydration is a leading cause of acute kidney injury

Your body keeps score. #shorts
